title: Publish centralized roadmap terminology and technology comparisons
instruction: Maintain one structured public reference artifact for roadmap terminology and comparison tables. Generate every displayed definition and comparison from that artifact rather than copying explanations across pages. Show year-only milestones as uncertainty ranges spanning Q1 through Q4, show supported half-year windows across two quarters, retain truly undated events separately, and add comparisons for decision-relevant technologies beyond memory. Keep the material bilingual, provisional, evidence-linked, and Consensus-incomplete until independent review.
